g.text: The generator writes train.csv, val.csv and test.csv over
as the test partition, so model selection never sees a signer
that is later used to report the result.
Gate 1 offers only flat, research-valid splits. LOSO and
matched-leak fold sets are deliberately withheld: they are
multi-run evaluation protocols, not a single training job.
Splits flagged valid_for_research = false are withheld too,
because Gate 2 would reject them anyway.
Three-valued, fail-closed. A criterion that cannot be decided from the
, but only when no criterion has definitely
failed; a definite failure always outranks an undecidable one.
What the fourteen criteria cover — C1 run intent (research, not the smoke_test default) | C2, C3 augmentation and
checkpoint contract fields | C4, C5 dataset and split versioning plus manifest checksum | C6, C7, C12 split metadata
present, research-valid, and a non-empty test set | C8, C9 recognition profile matches the labels, with no
cross-profile leakage | C10, C11 runtime environment and git commit recorded | C13, C14 metrics taken from the
restored best-validation checkpoint of a run that did not fail.
The assessment is never run inside training: it reads the stored checkpoint only when a user asks for it, and its
outcome is not written back to training_jobs.
